title: Canned Pumpkin 425g

drivers.name: Halloween (event week)
drivers.evidence: Noise-adjusted uplift x1.14 from 3 past occurrences; highest was x2.14 in 2025.

drivers.name: Heatwave (38°C)
drivers.evidence: Unprecedented heat in target week; no historical data on heat impact, but seasonal baked goods demand typically drops in extreme heat.

adjustment.analysis: Halloween drives a noise-adjusted uplift of x1.14, supported by 3 past occurrences. The price is unchanged (no discount), so no promotion effect. The heatwave (38°C) likely suppresses demand for seasonal baked goods; this is a new, untested driver with no historical parallel. Given the baseline's high noise (65%) and the single past seasonal spike (x2.14), the event effect is credible but modest. The uplift model's x1.14 is a reasonable starting point but doesn't account for heatwave risk. Shrink toward 1.0 to reflect uncertainty. No pantry-loading effect expected (no promotion recently).

This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-65% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
